<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=480,height=480,initial-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:480px;height:480px;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0e14}
body{display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;color:#e8edf5}
canvas{width:480px;height:480px;display:block;outline:none;background:#0b0e14;cursor:pointer}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="480" tabindex="0" aria-label="Snake game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const c = document.getElementById("game"), x = c.getContext("2d");
  const W=480,H=480, hud=58, size=400, offX=40, offY=66, n=20, cell=size/n;
  const dirs={ArrowUp:[0,-1],ArrowDown:[0,1],ArrowLeft:[-1,0],ArrowRight:[1,0],w:[0,-1],s:[0,1],a:[-1,0],d:[1,0],W:[0,-1],S:[0,1],A:[-1,0],D:[1,0]};
  let snake, dir, next, food, score, best=+localStorage.snakeBest||0, state, t=0, last=0, speed=92;

  function reset(ready=0){
    snake=[{x:9,y:10},{x:8,y:10},{x:7,y:10}]; dir=next=[1,0]; score=0; speed=92; state=ready?"ready":"run"; place(); draw(0);
  }
  function place(){
    do food={x:Math.random()*n|0,y:Math.random()*n|0};
    while(snake.some(p=>p.x==food.x&&p.y==food.y));
  }
  function start(){ if(state!="run"){ reset(); last=performance.now(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); } }
  function over(){ state="over"; best=Math.max(best,score); localStorage.snakeBest=best; draw(0); }
  function step(){
    if(state!="run") return;
    if(!(next[0]==-dir[0]&&next[1]==-dir[1])) dir=next;
    const h={x:snake[0].x+dir[0],y:snake[0].y+dir[1]};
    if(h.x<0||h.y<0||h.x>=n||h.y>=n||snake.some(p=>p.x==h.x&&p.y==h.y)) return over();
    snake.unshift(h);
    if(h.x==food.x&&h.y==food.y){ score++; speed=Math.max(58,92-score*1.4); place(); }
    else snake.pop();
  }
  function round(r,x0,y0,w,h){
    x.beginPath(); x.roundRect(x0,y0,w,h,r); x.fill();
  }
  function draw(now){
    x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    let g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); g.addColorStop(0,"#111722"); g.addColorStop(1,"#090c12");
    x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    x.fillStyle="#e8edf5"; x.font="700 22px system-ui"; x.textAlign="left"; x.fillText("Snake",40,34);
    x.font="600 14px system-ui"; x.fillStyle="#9aa6b8"; x.fillText("Score "+score,265,33); x.fillText("Best "+best,365,33);

    x.fillStyle="#151b26"; round(14,offX,offY,size,size);
    x.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.035)"; x.lineWidth=1;
    for(let i=1;i<n;i++){ x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(offX+i*cell,offY); x.lineTo(offX+i*cell,offY+size); x.moveTo(offX,offY+i*cell); x.lineTo(offX+size,offY+i*cell); x.stroke(); }

    const pulse=1+Math.sin(now/130)*.08, fx=offX+food.x*cell+cell/2, fy=offY+food.y*cell+cell/2;
    x.fillStyle="#ff5f6d"; x.beginPath(); x.arc(fx,fy,cell*.36*pulse,0,7); x.fill();
    x.fillStyle="rgba(255,95,109,.22)"; x.beginPath(); x.arc(fx,fy,cell*.55*pulse,0,7); x.fill();

    snake.forEach((p,i)=>{
      const px=offX+p.x*cell+2, py=offY+p.y*cell+2;
      x.fillStyle=i?`hsl(${142-i*.7},62%,${47-Math.min(i,14)}%)`:"#7cf29a";
      round(6,px,py,cell-4,cell-4);
      if(!i){ x.fillStyle="rgba(7,12,10,.55)"; x.beginPath(); x.arc(px+cell*.33,py+cell*.36,2.2,0,7); x.arc(px+cell*.63,py+cell*.36,2.2,0,7); x.fill(); }
    });

    if(state!="run"){
      x.fillStyle=state=="over"?"rgba(10,12,18,.72)":"rgba(10,12,18,.55)";
      round(18,82,174,316,124);
      x.textAlign="center";
      x.fillStyle="#fff"; x.font="800 28px system-ui"; x.fillText(state=="over"?"Game over":"Ready?",240,218);
      x.fillStyle="#b7c0cf"; x.font="600 15px system-ui";
      x.fillText(state=="over"?"Click, R, Enter or Space to restart":"Click or press an arrow/WASD to start",240,249);
    }
  }
  function loop(now){
    if(state!="run") return;
    if(now-last>speed){ last=now; step(); }
    draw(now); requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if(dirs[e.key]){ e.preventDefault(); next=dirs[e.key]; if(state!="run") start(); }
    else if((e.key=="r"||e.key=="R"||e.key==" "||e.key=="Enter")&&state!="run"){ e.preventDefault(); start(); }
  }, {passive:false});
  c.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => { c.focus(); if(state!="run") start(); });
  reset(1);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#080b10;display:grid;place-items:center}
canvas{width:480px;height:480px;max-width:100vmin;max-height:100vmin;display:block;background:#0d1320;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480" tabindex="0" aria-label="Breakout game"></canvas>
<script>
const C=document.getElementById("c"),x=C.getContext("2d"),W=480,H=480;
let dpr=1,bricks=[],parts=[],score=0,lives=3,state="serve",shake=0,last=0,keys={},target=240;
const p={x:240,y:438,w:86,h:12},ball={x:240,y:424,r:6,vx:0,vy:0,s:260};
function resize(){dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);C.width=W*dpr;C.height=H*dpr;x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}resize();addEventListener("resize",resize);
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function pathR(a,b,c,d,r){x.beginPath();x.moveTo(a+r,b);x.arcTo(a+c,b,a+c,b+d,r);x.arcTo(a+c,b+d,a,b+d,r);x.arcTo(a,b+d,a,b,r);x.arcTo(a,b,a+c,b,r);x.closePath()}
function makeBricks(){bricks=[];let cols=9,rows=6,g=6,bw=(W-64-g*(cols-1))/cols,bh=18,cs=["#ff6b7a","#ff9f43","#ffd166","#67d98f","#45b7ff","#9b8cff"];for(let r=0;r<rows;r++)for(let c=0;c<cols;c++)bricks.push({x:32+c*(bw+g),y:72+r*(bh+g),w:bw,h:bh,c:cs[r],on:1})}
function newGame(){score=0;lives=3;makeBricks();serve()}
function serve(){state="serve";p.x=target=240;ball.x=p.x;ball.y=p.y-ball.r-1;ball.vx=ball.vy=0;ball.s=260}
function launch(){if(state==="over"||state==="won")return newGame();if(state!=="serve")return;state="run";let a=(Math.random()-.5)*.7;ball.vx=Math.sin(a)*ball.s;ball.vy=-Math.cos(a)*ball.s}
function spark(px,py,c,n=10){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let a=Math.random()*7,t=.25+Math.random()*.35,s=50+Math.random()*130;parts.push({x:px,y:py,vx:Math.cos(a)*s,vy:Math.sin(a)*s,t,l:t,c})}}
function circleRect(o){let cx=clamp(ball.x,o.x,o.x+o.w),cy=clamp(ball.y,o.y,o.y+o.h),dx=ball.x-cx,dy=ball.y-cy;return dx*dx+dy*dy<=ball.r*ball.r}
function update(dt){
 let dir=(keys.ArrowRight||keys.d?1:0)-(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.a?1:0);
 if(dir){p.x+=dir*430*dt;target=p.x}else p.x+=(target-p.x)*Math.min(1,dt*18);
 p.x=clamp(p.x,p.w/2+10,W-p.w/2-10);
 parts=parts.filter(q=>(q.t-=dt)>0);parts.forEach(q=>{q.x+=q.vx*dt;q.y+=q.vy*dt;q.vy+=180*dt});
 if(shake)shake=Math.max(0,shake-28*dt);
 if(state==="serve"){ball.x=p.x;ball.y=p.y-ball.r-1;return}
 if(state!=="run")return;
 let px=ball.x,py=ball.y;ball.x+=ball.vx*dt;ball.y+=ball.vy*dt;
 if(ball.x<ball.r){ball.x=ball.r;ball.vx=Math.abs(ball.vx);shake=2}
 if(ball.x>W-ball.r){ball.x=W-ball.r;ball.vx=-Math.abs(ball.vx);shake=2}
 if(ball.y<46+ball.r){ball.y=46+ball.r;ball.vy=Math.abs(ball.vy);shake=2}
 let pad={x:p.x-p.w/2,y:p.y,w:p.w,h:p.h};
 if(ball.vy>0&&circleRect(pad)){let hit=(ball.x-p.x)/(p.w/2),ang=hit*1.05;ball.s=Math.min(430,ball.s*1.025);ball.vx=Math.sin(ang)*ball.s;ball.vy=-Math.cos(ang)*ball.s;ball.y=p.y-ball.r-.2;spark(ball.x,ball.y,"#dff6ff",6)}
 for(let b of bricks)if(b.on&&circleRect(b)){b.on=0;score+=10;shake=4;spark(ball.x,ball.y,b.c,12);
   if(px+ball.r<=b.x){ball.vx=-Math.abs(ball.vx);ball.x=b.x-ball.r}
   else if(px-ball.r>=b.x+b.w){ball.vx=Math.abs(ball.vx);ball.x=b.x+b.w+ball.r}
   else if(py+ball.r<=b.y){ball.vy=-Math.abs(ball.vy);ball.y=b.y-ball.r}
   else if(py-ball.r>=b.y+b.h){ball.vy=Math.abs(ball.vy);ball.y=b.y+b.h+ball.r}
   else ball.vy*=-1;
   if(!bricks.some(k=>k.on)){state="won";spark(W/2,180,"#ffd166",50)}
   break
 }
 if(ball.y>H+20){lives--;shake=10;if(lives>0)serve();else state="over"}
}
function draw(){
 let g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);g.addColorStop(0,"#111a2b");g.addColorStop(1,"#080b10");x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 x.save();if(shake)x.translate((Math.random()-.5)*shake,(Math.random()-.5)*shake);
 x.globalAlpha=.18;x.strokeStyle="#7aa2ff";x.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<9;i++){x.moveTo(0,52+i*46);x.lineTo(W,20+i*46)}x.stroke();x.globalAlpha=1;
 x.fillStyle="#dce7ff";x.font="600 15px system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif";x.textAlign="left";x.fillText("SCORE "+score,20,29);
 x.textAlign="right";x.fillText("LIVES",404,29);for(let i=0;i<lives;i++){x.fillStyle=["#ff6b7a","#ff8a98","#ffc0c8"][i%3];x.beginPath();x.arc(424+i*16,24,5,0,7);x.fill()}
 x.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.12)";x.beginPath();x.moveTo(18,45);x.lineTo(462,45);x.stroke();
 for(let b of bricks)if(b.on){let bg=x.createLinearGradient(0,b.y,0,b.y+b.h);bg.addColorStop(0,"#ffffff");bg.addColorStop(.08,b.c);bg.addColorStop(1,b.c);x.fillStyle=bg;x.shadowColor=b.c;x.shadowBlur=7;pathR(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h,5);x.fill();x.shadowBlur=0}
 parts.forEach(q=>{x.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,q.t/q.l);x.fillStyle=q.c;x.beginPath();x.arc(q.x,q.y,2.2,0,7);x.fill();x.globalAlpha=1});
 let pg=x.createLinearGradient(p.x-p.w/2,p.y,p.x+p.w/2,p.y+p.h);pg.addColorStop(0,"#68e1fd");pg.addColorStop(.5,"#e6fbff");pg.addColorStop(1,"#7a8cff");x.fillStyle=pg;x.shadowColor="#69dfff";x.shadowBlur=10;pathR(p.x-p.w/2,p.y,p.w,p.h,7);x.fill();x.shadowBlur=0;
 let rg=x.createRadialGradient(ball.x-2,ball.y-2,1,ball.x,ball.y,ball.r+2);rg.addColorStop(0,"#fff");rg.addColorStop(.45,"#eaf8ff");rg.addColorStop(1,"#77d7ff");x.fillStyle=rg;x.beginPath();x.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,7);x.fill();
 if(state!=="run"){x.fillStyle="rgba(8,11,16,.58)";x.fillRect(0,56,W,342);x.textAlign="center";x.fillStyle="#f4f8ff";x.font="700 34px system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif";x.fillText(state==="won"?"CLEARED!":state==="over"?"GAME OVER":"BREAKOUT",240,215);x.font="500 15px system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif";x.fillStyle="#b9c7df";x.fillText(state==="serve"?"Move paddle • Space/click to launch":"Space/click to restart",240,245)}
 x.restore()
}
function frame(t){let dt=Math.min(.033,(t-last)/1000||0);last=t;update(dt);draw();requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{keys[e.key]=1;if(e.key===" "||e.key==="Enter"){e.preventDefault();launch()}});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>keys[e.key]=0);
C.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{let r=C.getBoundingClientRect();target=clamp((e.clientX-r.left)*W/r.width,p.w/2+10,W-p.w/2-10)});
C.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{C.focus();C.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);launch()});
newGame();requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #0a0a0f;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 480px;
    height: 480px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    background: #0d0d1a;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = c.getContext('2d');

const W = 480, H = 480;
const ROWS = 6, COLS = 10;
const BW = 40, BH = 14, BPAD = 3;
const BOFF_X = 10, BOFF_Y = 48;

const COLORS = ['#ff4d6d','#ff7c43','#ffd166','#06d6a0','#4cc9f0','#7b2d8b'];

let paddle, ball, bricks, score, lives, state, keys;

function init() {
  paddle = { x: W/2 - 36, y: H - 30, w: 72, h: 10, speed: 6 };
  ball = { x: W/2, y: H - 50, vx: 3, vy: -4, r: 7, active: false };
  score = 0;
  lives = 3;
  state = 'ready';
  keys = {};
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++)
    for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++)
      bricks.push({ x: BOFF_X + col*(BW+BPAD), y: BOFF_Y + r*(BH+BPAD), alive: true, color: COLORS[r] });
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w/2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 2;
  ball.vx = 3 * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
  ball.vy = -4;
  ball.active = false;
  state = 'ready';
}

function drawRoundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w-r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w, y+h-r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w, y+h, x+w-r, y+h);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r, y+h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y+h, x, y+h-r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y+r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x+r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = fill;
  ctx.fill();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Grid lines subtle
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i,0); ctx.lineTo(i,H); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (let i = 0; i < H; i += 40) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,i); ctx.lineTo(W,i); ctx.stroke(); }

  // Bricks
  bricks.forEach(b => {
    if (!b.alive) return;
    drawRoundRect(b.x, b.y, BW, BH, 3, b.color);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    drawRoundRect(b.x+2, b.y+2, BW-4, 4, 2, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)');
  });

  // Paddle
  const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.x, paddle.y+paddle.h);
  pg.addColorStop(0, '#a0c4ff');
  pg.addColorStop(1, '#4895ef');
  drawRoundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 5, pg);

  // Ball
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ball.x-2, ball.y-2, 1, ball.x, ball.y, ball.r);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#a0c4ff');
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fill();

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '13px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE ' + score, 10, 22);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES ' + '● '.repeat(lives).trim(), W-10, 22);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  // Messages
  if (state === 'ready') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('PRESS SPACE OR TAP TO LAUNCH', W/2, H/2 + 60);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
  if (state === 'over') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4d6d';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', W/2, H/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 14);
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or tap to restart', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
  if (state === 'win') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#06d6a0';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('YOU WIN!', W/2, H/2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W/2, H/2 + 14);
    ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or tap to restart', W/2, H/2 + 40);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  }
}

function update() {
  if (state === 'over' || state === 'win') return;

  // Paddle movement
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) paddle.x = Math.max(0, paddle.x - paddle.speed);
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) paddle.x = Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x + paddle.speed);

  if (!ball.active) {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w/2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 2;
    return;
  }

  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;

  // Wall collisions
  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Ball lost
  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) { state = 'over'; return; }
    resetBall();
    return;
  }

  // Paddle collision
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.x > paddle.x && ball.x < paddle.x + paddle.w &&
      ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y + ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h + 4) {
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    let rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w/2)) / (paddle.w/2);
    let angle = rel * 1.1;
    let speed = Math.sqrt(ball.vx*ball.vx + ball.vy*ball.vy);
    ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -Math.abs(speed * Math.cos(angle));
    if (Math.abs(ball.vy) < 2) ball.vy = -2;
  }

  // Brick collisions
  let hit = false;
  for (let b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    if (ball.x + ball.r > b.x && ball.x - ball.r < b.x + BW &&
        ball.y + ball.r > b.y && ball.y - ball.r < b.y + BH) {
      b.alive = false;
      score += 10;
      if (!hit) {
        const overlapL = ball.x + ball.r - b.x;
        const overlapR = b.x + BW - (ball.x - ball.r);
        const overlapT = ball.y + ball.r - b.y;
        const overlapB = b.y + BH - (ball.y - ball.r);
        const minH = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
        const minV = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
        if (minH < minV) ball.vx = -ball.vx;
        else ball.vy = -ball.vy;
        hit = true;
      }
    }
  }

  if (bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) state = 'win';
}

let lastTime = 0;
function loop(ts) {
  if (ts - lastTime >= 16) {
    update();
    draw();
    lastTime = ts;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state === 'ready') { ball.active = true; state = 'playing'; }
    else if (state === 'over' || state === 'win') { init(); }
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// Pointer / touch controls
let pointerX = null;
c.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scaleX = W / rect.width;
  pointerX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, pointerX - paddle.w/2));
});
c.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scaleX = W / rect.width;
  pointerX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, pointerX - paddle.w/2));
  if (state === 'ready') { ball.active = true; state = 'playing'; }
  else if (state === 'over' || state === 'win') { init(); }
});

init();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0e1117}
body{display:grid;place-items:center}
canvas{width:480px;height:480px;max-width:100vmin;max-height:100vmin;background:#111827;touch-action:none;display:block}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" aria-label="Pong game"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const S=480, c=document.getElementById("c"), x=c.getContext("2d");
  let dpr=1, keys={}, last=0, wait=0, ready=1, over=0, pulse=0, msg="PONG";
  const P={x:28,y:202,w:10,h:76,vy:0,score:0}, A={x:442,y:202,w:10,h:76,score:0};
  const B={x:240,y:240,r:6,vx:0,vy:0,s:5};

  function fit(){
    dpr=Math.max(1,devicePixelRatio||1);
    c.width=c.height=S*dpr; x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  }
  addEventListener("resize",fit,{passive:true}); fit();

  const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const start=()=>{ if(over) reset(); if(ready){ready=0; serve(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)} };
  function reset(){ P.score=A.score=0; over=0; ready=1; msg="PONG"; center(); }
  function center(){ P.y=A.y=(S-P.h)/2; B.x=B.y=S/2; B.vx=B.vy=0; B.s=5; wait=performance.now()+450; }
  function serve(dir){
    B.x=S/2; B.y=S/2; B.s=5;
    const a=(Math.random()*0.55-.275);
    B.vx=dir*B.s*Math.cos(a); B.vy=B.s*Math.sin(a);
    wait=performance.now()+650;
  }
  function point(side){
    side>0?P.score++:A.score++; pulse=1;
    if(P.score>=7||A.score>=7){ over=1; msg=P.score>A.score?"YOU WIN":"GAME OVER"; center(); return; }
    serve(side);
  }
  function hit(p,side){
    const o=((B.y-(p.y+p.h/2))/(p.h/2));
    const a=o*1.05, sp=B.s=Math.min(8.6,B.s+.35);
    B.vx=side*sp*Math.cos(a); B.vy=sp*Math.sin(a);
    B.x=side>0?p.x+p.w+B.r:p.x-B.r; pulse=.55;
  }

  addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
    if(["ArrowUp","ArrowDown","w","W","s","S"," "].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
    keys[e.key]=1; if(e.key===" ") start();
    if(e.key!==" ") ready&&start();
  });
  addEventListener("keyup",e=>keys[e.key]=0);
  c.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{ c.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); move(e); start(); });
  c.addEventListener("pointermove",move);
  function move(e){
    const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();
    P.y=clamp((e.clientY-r.top)*S/r.height-P.h/2,12,S-P.h-12);
  }

  function update(t){
    const dt=Math.min(1.6,(t-last)/16.666||1); last=t;
    if(pulse>0) pulse=Math.max(0,pulse-.04*dt);

    if((keys.ArrowUp||keys.w||keys.W)&&(P.y>12)) P.y-=6.2*dt;
    if((keys.ArrowDown||keys.s||keys.S)&&(P.y<S-P.h-12)) P.y+=6.2*dt;
    P.y=clamp(P.y,12,S-P.h-12);

    if(!ready&&!over&&t>wait){
      B.x+=B.vx*dt; B.y+=B.vy*dt;
      if(B.y<B.r+10){B.y=B.r+10;B.vy=Math.abs(B.vy);pulse=.25}
      if(B.y>S-B.r-10){B.y=S-B.r-10;B.vy=-Math.abs(B.vy);pulse=.25}

      const target=(B.vx>0?B.y:S/2+Math.sin(t/450)*60), ay=A.y+A.h/2;
      A.y+=clamp(target-ay,-4.7*dt,4.7*dt);
      A.y=clamp(A.y,12,S-A.h-12);

      if(B.vx<0 && B.x-B.r<P.x+P.w && B.x>P.x && B.y+B.r>P.y && B.y-B.r<P.y+P.h) hit(P,1);
      if(B.vx>0 && B.x+B.r>A.x && B.x<A.x+A.w && B.y+B.r>A.y && B.y-B.r<A.y+A.h) hit(A,-1);
      if(B.x<-25) point(-1);
      if(B.x>S+25) point(1);
    }
    draw(t); requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }

  function rect(px,py,w,h,r,fill){
    x.fillStyle=fill; x.beginPath(); x.roundRect(px,py,w,h,r); x.fill();
  }
  function draw(t){
    x.fillStyle="#0f172a"; x.fillRect(0,0,S,S);
    if(pulse){ x.fillStyle=`rgba(56,189,248,${pulse*.12})`; x.fillRect(0,0,S,S); }

    x.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.09)"; x.lineWidth=2;
    x.setLineDash([8,12]); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(S/2,26); x.lineTo(S/2,S-26); x.stroke(); x.setLineDash([]);

    x.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.06)";
    x.font="700 96px system-ui,sans-serif"; x.textAlign="center"; x.textBaseline="middle";
    x.fillText(P.score,170,86); x.fillText(A.score,310,86);

    rect(P.x,P.y,P.w,P.h,6,"#e5e7eb"); rect(A.x,A.y,A.w,A.h,6,"#94a3b8");
    x.beginPath(); x.arc(B.x,B.y,B.r,0,7); x.fillStyle="#f8fafc"; x.fill();
    x.shadowColor="rgba(125,211,252,.75)"; x.shadowBlur=14; x.fill(); x.shadowBlur=0;

    x.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.08)"; x.lineWidth=1; x.strokeRect(10,10,S-20,S-20);

    if(ready||over||performance.now()<wait){
      x.fillStyle="rgba(15,23,42,.62)"; x.fillRect(0,0,S,S);
      x.fillStyle="#f8fafc"; x.font="800 42px system-ui,sans-serif"; x.textAlign="center";
      x.fillText(over?msg:ready?"PONG":"",S/2,198);
      x.fillStyle="rgba(226,232,240,.82)"; x.font="500 15px system-ui,sans-serif";
      x.fillText(over?"Press Space or click to restart":"Move with mouse/touch, W/S or ↑/↓",S/2,245);
      if(ready) x.fillText("Press Space or click to serve",S/2,270);
    }
  }

  if(!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect){
    CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect=function(a,b,w,h,r){this.moveTo(a+r,b);this.arcTo(a+w,b,a+w,b+h,r);this.arcTo(a+w,b+h,a,b+h,r);this.arcTo(a,b+h,a,b,r);this.arcTo(a,b,a+w,b,r);return this};
  }
  center(); requestAnimationFrame(update);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #111;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 480px;
    height: 480px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = c.getContext('2d');

const W = 480, H = 480;
const PW = 10, PH = 70, BALL = 8;
const WIN = 7;

let state = 'start';
let scores = [0, 0];
let ball, player, ai, particles;

function reset(serveDir) {
  const angle = (Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25) + (serveDir < 0 ? Math.PI : 0);
  const speed = 4.5;
  ball = {
    x: W / 2, y: H / 2,
    vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
    vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
    speed
  };
  player = { x: 20, y: H / 2 - PH / 2, vy: 0 };
  ai = { x: W - 20 - PW, y: H / 2 - PH / 2 };
  particles = [];
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, color) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const s = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
    particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: 1, color });
  }
}

let keys = {};
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);

let pointerY = null;
c.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointerY = e.clientY - r.top;
});
c.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointerY = e.touches[0].clientY - r.top;
}, { passive: false });
c.addEventListener('click', () => { if (state !== 'play') startGame(); });
c.addEventListener('touchend', () => { if (state !== 'play') startGame(); });

function startGame() {
  scores = [0, 0];
  reset(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
  state = 'play';
}

function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }

function update() {
  if (state !== 'play') return;

  // Player movement
  if (pointerY !== null) {
    const target = pointerY - PH / 2;
    player.y += (target - player.y) * 0.2;
  } else {
    if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w'] || keys['W']) player.y -= 5;
    if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s'] || keys['S']) player.y += 5;
  }
  player.y = clamp(player.y, 0, H - PH);

  // AI movement
  const aiCenter = ai.y + PH / 2;
  const diff = ball.y - aiCenter;
  const aiSpeed = 3.8;
  ai.y += clamp(diff, -aiSpeed, aiSpeed);
  ai.y = clamp(ai.y, 0, H - PH);

  // Ball movement
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;

  // Top/bottom bounce
  if (ball.y - BALL < 0) { ball.y = BALL; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
  if (ball.y + BALL > H) { ball.y = H - BALL; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Paddle collision helper
  function paddleHit(px, py) {
    return ball.x - BALL < px + PW && ball.x + BALL > px &&
           ball.y - BALL < py + PH && ball.y + BALL > py;
  }

  // Player paddle
  if (ball.vx < 0 && paddleHit(player.x, player.y)) {
    ball.x = player.x + PW + BALL;
    const rel = (ball.y - (player.y + PH / 2)) / (PH / 2);
    const angle = rel * (Math.PI / 3.5);
    ball.speed = Math.min(ball.speed + 0.3, 12);
    ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * ball.speed;
    spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, '#4af');
  }

  // AI paddle
  if (ball.vx > 0 && paddleHit(ai.x, ai.y)) {
    ball.x = ai.x - BALL;
    const rel = (ball.y - (ai.y + PH / 2)) / (PH / 2);
    const angle = Math.PI - rel * (Math.PI / 3.5);
    ball.speed = Math.min(ball.speed + 0.3, 12);
    ball.vx = Math.cos(angle) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = Math.sin(angle) * ball.speed;
    spawnParticles(ball.x, ball.y, '#f84');
  }

  // Scoring
  if (ball.x + BALL < 0) {
    spawnParticles(ball.x + BALL, ball.y, '#f44');
    scores[1]++;
    if (scores[1] >= WIN) { state = 'over'; return; }
    reset(1);
  }
  if (ball.x - BALL > W) {
    spawnParticles(ball.x - BALL, ball.y, '#4f4');
    scores[0]++;
    if (scores[0] >= WIN) { state = 'over'; return; }
    reset(-1);
  }

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
    p.vx *= 0.92; p.vy *= 0.92;
    p.life -= 0.04;
  });
  particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Center line
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 10]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  if (state === 'start' || state === 'over') {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    if (state === 'start') {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 36px monospace';
      ctx.fillText('PONG', W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
      ctx.font = '16px monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.fillText('Click or tap to start', W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.font = '13px monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
      ctx.fillText('Arrow keys / WASD / pointer to move', W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
    } else {
      const winner = scores[0] >= WIN ? 'YOU WIN' : 'AI WINS';
      const col = scores[0] >= WIN ? '#4af' : '#f84';
      ctx.fillStyle = col;
      ctx.font = 'bold 38px monospace';
      ctx.fillText(winner, W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
      ctx.font = '16px monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
      ctx.fillText(`${scores[0]} — ${scores[1]}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.fillText('Click or tap to restart', W / 2, H / 2 + 40);
    }
    return;
  }

  // Scores
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.font = 'bold 40px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
  ctx.fillText(scores[0], W / 2 - 60, 52);
  ctx.fillText(scores[1], W / 2 + 60, 52);

  // Particles
  particles.forEach(p => {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // Paddles
  const rr = 4;
  function drawPaddle(x, y, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(x, y, PW, PH, rr);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  drawPaddle(player.x, player.y, '#4af');
  drawPaddle(ai.x, ai.y, '#f84');

  // Ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#fff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
